The structure of Ho4Cu2Sn2O12 (reduced formula Ho2CuSnO6) is orthorhombic with space group Amm2 (No. 38), containing 20 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cu in a tetrahedral environment of four O neighbors, Ho in an octahedral environment of six O neighbors, and Sn in a four-coordinate environment with four O neighbors. The Cu tetrahedra and Ho octahedra share corners, while Ho octahedra also share corners with Sn polyhedra; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
